beats.care: If you just turned 18 or moved cities, check your name is on the voter list. It's your vote.
beats.what: About 500 people marched in Delhi to demand SIR be scrapped and CEC Gyanesh Kumar resign. Police detained some of them.
beats.why: Scores of scientists from IISc, IIT Delhi and other institutes wrote to the EC saying poor and migrant voters are being wrongly removed. Punjab's Assembly passed a resolution seeking a probe.

cards.body: Police said about 20 were detained and released; protesters said about 50. One FIR was filed for breaking prohibitory orders. Farmers' group SKM held protests at district offices across the country.
The EC has ordered fresh checks in some States, including Delhi.
cards.caption: Names removed from voter rolls under SIR

a.body: Eligible voters, especially poor and migrant ones, are deleted with no easy way back. The process lacks transparency.
a.label: Critics say

b.body: Congress and allies are using protests to create 'anarchy' in Delhi.
b.label: BJP says

cards.q: Have you checked your name on the voter list?

opts: Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls
cards.q: What does SIR stand for in this story?
cards.why: SIR is the Election Commission's special intensive revision of electoral rolls.

hook: *13 crore* names cut from voter lists. Now students and scientists push back

learn.t: Scientists signing the letter said the right to vote is a basic pillar of democracy and nobody should lose it through unclear procedures.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Students and activists rally in Delhi seeking CEC exit, SIR rollback (print, Hyderabad edition, 24 Oct, p.1)

tldr: Students, farmers and scientists protested the voter-list clean-up (SIR) and demanded the Chief Election Commissioner quit. Punjab's Assembly wants a probe.
watch: Another big protest is planned in Delhi on November 1. Watch the results of the EC's fresh verification.
